title: Message from a cron job
description: Nudge an agent on a timetable from the system crontab.

sections.title: Crontab entry
paragraphs: Sends a plain-text prompt to an existing agent. If the agent is busy, the message waits in its queue. For prompts that should run in a fresh session each time, use Bureau’s built-in Schedules instead.
sections.code:
# crontab -e — ask an agent for a status summary every weekday at 9:00.
# cron entries are single lines; keep the token in a file only you can read.
BUREAU_URL=http://localhost:4000
0 9 * * 1-5  curl -s -X POST "$BUREAU_URL/api/agents/AGENT_ID/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.bureau-token)" -H "Content-Type: text/plain" --data "Post a status summary of yesterday's merges."
